Detailing 101

Know Your Detail

The important stuff, in plain words — so you know exactly what you are paying for.

Detail vs. Correction

A detail cleans and protects your car. Paint correction is different — it is machine polishing that permanently removes swirls, scratches and oxidation from the clear coat. It is the only way to actually remove defects. Waxes and fillers just hide them for a few weeks.

What the Stages Mean

Every scratch sits at a depth, and the stage you need depends on how deep yours go. Light swirls and fine scratches live on the surface of the clear coat — one stage removes about 70–80% of defects. Deeper scratches need a cutting stage to level them, then a refining stage to restore the gloss — that is two stages, about 85–90%. Three stages chase the deepest defects polishing can reach, 95%+. The fingernail test tells the truth: drag a nail across the scratch — if it catches, it has likely cut through the clear coat into the paint, and no amount of polishing brings it back. That needs repaint, and a good detailer tells you before you pay.

Ceramic Coating vs. Wax

Wax lasts weeks. A sealant lasts months. A ceramic coating chemically bonds to the paint and lasts for years — the Makeovers use a 10-year coating. It adds deep gloss, blocks UV and chemical damage, and makes washing far easier because dirt struggles to stick.

What a Coating Can't Do

The honest part: a coating is not armor. It will not stop rock chips or deep scratches — that takes paint protection film. What it does stop is wash swirls, bird-dropping etching, sun fading, and grime bonding into your paint. Think of it as a hard, sacrificial skin over the paint.

Why the Wheels Come Off

With a wheel on the car, only the face can be cleaned. Off the car, the barrel, the caliper and the wheel well get fully cleaned, and the whole wheel gets ceramic coated — brake dust stops sticking and future washes take minutes. Same idea with tire coating: dressings sling off and fade in weeks, while a permanent coating bonds and lasts the life of the tire.

Aftercare That Matters

Keep a fresh coating dry while it cures, then wash by hand with pH-neutral soap — automatic brush washes are the fastest way to swirl coated paint. A maintenance wash every few weeks keeps the coating performing for its full life. And skip the wax: the coating replaces it.

Questions

Good To Know

Do you come to me?

Yes. Mobile Detail Bros is fully mobile — we detail your vehicle at your home or workplace. You pick the day and time that works for you.

How do I book?

Use the booking builder on this page. Pick your ride, your detail, a day and a time, then tap Book My Detail. Your booking is confirmed when Peter replies and approves it.

What is Permanent Tire Coating?

It lasts the life of the tire, is dry to the touch, and does not sling onto your paint like regular tire dressing. One application — $200.

What does headlight restoration fix?

Cloudy, yellowed headlights are polished back to clear and sealed for protection. Restoration is $145.
